Capping concurrency at 2 in the rollout configuration resolves this — no separate deployment needed.

Before I settle, I want to confirm one thing with Taylor: Can Customer Operations commit to sending the 72-hour notices to those six customers by Saturday 10:00 UTC? If yes, I'm prepared to approve the flag with the following configuration: 5% cohort, max concurrency of 2, manual-review fallback enabled, $8,000 cost alert, and the six named customers excluded while retaining human review. If the notices cannot go out by Saturday, we'll need to discuss whether to delay Tuesday's enablement entirely or proceed with the exclusions in place. Please confirm.
